source.design: Original AEGIS armour authored for this project (art/aegis-hero): signed-distance hard-surface modelling, meshed and baked in Blender 4.5.
source.rig: Skeleton and 16 animation clips from the Godot TPS demo robot (CC-BY-3.0, Juan Linietsky, Fernando Miguel Calabro), re-proportioned to a 185 cm human. See public/assets/asset-manifest.json and LICENSE-godot.txt.
source.motion: Idle, walk and run are retargeted from the CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (BVH conversion by B. Hahne; sources in art/aegis-hero/source/mocap). The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217. Free for use in research and commercial projects.
